description:
Get ready for the life of a stray cat where boredom doesn’t exist. Complete quirky and fun tasks: kick a ball, interact with other cats, find items, jump around, dig, and explore.

Every mission is a chance to create a bit of chaos in cozy yet unpredictable urban landscapes. How you tackle the tasks is up to you — cleverly, playfully… or just with pure cat attitude.

Be free, be curious — and show the world that even an ordinary backyard can become the stage for unforgettable adventures.
name: Bodycam Stray Kitty
intro: Furry, fun, and full of surprises.
